title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
@cursor Part 3 of 5 for issue #4: Incremental DOM mutations.

Read AGENTS.md (sections Parts and QA), .cursor/rules (including 90-lessons.mdc) and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md first. Read the whole issue #4, then do ONLY Part 3.

Work test-first: first a test commit `test(recorder): record insert positions and apply privacy to mutations (#4)` with the tests and the smallest stubs so typecheck passes, then the implementation commit.

Prompt: Record `parentId` and `nextId` for adds. Apply masking, blocking and script stripping to mutations.

Requirements:
- Password typed into a new input never recorded
- `nextId` is `null` for last child

Checks you must run before pushing:
- `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build` pass
- Tests: insertBefore in the middle, append, masked element added later

Implementation commit message: `feat(recorder): record insert positions and apply privacy to mutations (#4)`

Author every commit as the owner and credit yourself: `git -c user.name="Sergei Kamalian" -c user.email="106472907+SergeiKamalian@users.noreply.github.com" commit --trailer "Co-authored-by: Cursor Agent <cursoragent@cursor.com>" ...`.

If you make a decision a reviewer might question, add an ADR in docs/decisions/ and list it in docs/decisions/README.md.
